reason: The County groundwater-extraction report indexes 2024 large-system water use per connection class, but the opened source returned 403 and those acre-foot-per-connection figures do not provide full-county residential gallons per capita per day. District-level utility production is not a full-county resident denominator.
nearest_data: County of Monterey 2024 draft groundwater extraction summary indexed water use by connection class for 2020–2024: https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/142365/638926748365700000 (403 on open). Monterey Peninsula Water Management District annual reports and production reports were opened, but their service territory is a subset of the county and cannot stand in for all residents.
